content: Model a toy car: body is 200x100x100. Subtract 50x100x50 from a top front edge for the windshield. Add four 25-radius, 10-thick wheels aligned at the bottom corners, half embedded into body to form semicylindrical protrusions. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

# The body is 200x100x100, wheels are 25-radius, 10-thick, half embedded
# Wheels are aligned at the bottom corners

# Front left wheel
front_left_x = 25
front_left_y = 0
front_left_z = 25

# Front right wheel
front_right_x = 25
front_right_y = 100
front_right_z = 25

# Rear left wheel
rear_left_x = 175
rear_left_y = 0
rear_left_z = 25

# Rear right wheel
rear_right_x = 175
rear_right_y = 100
rear_right_z = 25

# Windshield subtraction starts at (0, 0, 50) and is 50x100x50
windshield_x = 0
windshield_y = 0
windshield_z = 50

# Return all positions
positions = {
    "front_left": (front_left_x, front_left_y, front_left_z),
    "front_right": (front_right_x, front_right_y, front_right_z),
    "rear_left": (rear_left_x, rear_left_y, rear_left_z),
    "rear_right": (rear_right_x, rear_right_y, rear_right_z),
    "windshield": (windshield_x, windshield_y, windshield_z)
}
positions"}
